name: motif_edit_natural_class
description:
Edit a natural class. Research first: motif_guide topic nasal-assimilation or conditioned-allomorphs; check best practice. Use only if the class lacks a sound its pattern needs or has one it must not; otherwise author a separate class. Every listed user changes with it (guide nasal-assimilation). Adds or removes phonemes from one existing segment natural class after checking its exact current members. The response lists rules, environments and insertions that still use the class. Only a person can Apply.
Command: compose-edit-natural-class. Agent class: Draft.
DraftName: The name of the Draft being authored.
IntentJson: The closed semantic intent JSON accepted by this composer.

target.description: Canonical id, exact natural class name or abbreviation; names use NFD and ordinal case-insensitive equality, without trimming.

expected_members.description: Exact current phoneme ids in the class; copy all members[].id from a detailed motif_grammar natural_classes listing.

members.description: Requested distinct phoneme ids; the class must remain nonempty.

project.description: Known project name or recorded .fwdata path.
